P.name: The Hitman and the Seer
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Aphelios''' has access to an arsenal of 5 ''Moonstone Weapons'', created by his sister '''Alune'''. He equips two weapons at any one time, one as his {{as|main weapon}} and one as his {{as|off-hand}}. Each weapon has a unique {{tip|basic attack}} and effect.
P.description2: '''Aphelios''' begins the game with {{ai|Calibrum|Aphelios}} as his {{as|main weapon}} and {{ai|Severum|Aphelios}} in his {{as|off-hand}}, with {{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}}, {{ai|Infernum|Aphelios}}, and {{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}} queued in reserve. His weapons are initially in this order, but they can be rearranged based on their usage.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Moonlight:}} Weapons granted to '''Aphelios''' have 50 ''Moonlight'' for [[ammunition]], which is consumed upon basic attacking {{tip|on-attack}} and upon casting his {{cci|Q.png|champion ability|primary abilities}}. Any of his abilities that automatically cause him to attack during their effect will not consume additional ''Moonlight''. Once his {{as|main weapon's}} ''Moonlight'' is exhausted, it is moved to the end of the reserve queue; '''Alune''' then assembles his next available weapon from the reserve over 1 second, placing its {{cci|Q.png|champion ability|primary ability}} on a {{fd|1.5}}-second {{sti|cooldown}} from the start of the assembly. '''Aphelios''' cannot cast ''{{ai|Phase|Aphelios}}'' during the assembly.
P.description4: {{sbc|Innate - Weapon Master:}} '''Aphelios''' cannot improve his abilities via [[Experience (champion)|skill points]]. He starts the game with ''{{ai|Phase|Aphelios}}'' and automatically gains access to his [[File:Q.png|20px|link=]] primary abilities at level 2 and his [[File:R.png|20px|link=]] ultimate ability, ''{{ai|Moonlight Vigil|Aphelios}}'', at level 6. ''{{ai|Moonlight Vigil|Aphelios}}'' improves automatically at levels 11 and 16. '''Aphelios''' may spend his skill points to gain {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack damage}}}}, {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} or {{sti|{{as|lethality}}}} instead.

P.name: Calibrum
P.description: '''Aphelios''' gains {{sti|range|100 '''bonus''' attack range}} while '''Calibrum''' is his {{as|main weapon}}. Enemies damaged by '''Calibrum''' through an ability are marked for {{fd|4.5}} seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. '''Aphelios' ''' next basic attack against a marked target uses the current {{as|off-hand}} weapon and has {{sti|range|1800 range}}, increased missile speed, and a brief cast time that lasts shorter based on '''Aphelios' ''' proximity to the target.
P.description2: The empowered attack will consume the marks from all targets, dealing {{as|15|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 15% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to the main target for each mark consumed. If '''Calibrum''' is the current {{as|off-hand}} weapon, the {{as|main weapon}} is used for the attack instead.

P.name: Severum
P.description: Basic attacks with '''Severum''' are {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}} and have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}. '''Severum's''' attacks {{tip|heal}} '''Aphelios''' for {{pp|key=%|2 to 7.1|formula=1.7% + 0.3% * level, capped at level 18|color=heal}}<!--stops at 18-->  of the {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt, increased to {{pp|5 to 17.75|key=%|formula=4.25% + 0.75% * level, capped at level 18|color=heal}}<!--stops at 18--> for attacks from abilities.
P.description2: Healing from '''Severum''' in excess of '''Aphelios' ''' {{as|{{sti|'''maximum''' health}}}} is converted into a {{tip|shield}} for an amount of up to {{pp|10; then +10*x|1;6 to 20 by 1}} {{as|(+ 6% '''maximum''' health)}}, lingering for up to 30 seconds.

P.name: Gravitum
P.description: Basic attacks with '''Gravitum''' {{tip|slow}} enemies by 30% for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, decaying to 10% after {{fd|0.7}} seconds.

P.name: Infernum
P.description: Basic attacks with '''Infernum''' shoot a fire bolt that upon arrival splits into a cone of 4 lesser bolts behind the target, dealing damage to enemies they pass through. The fire bolt deals {{as|110% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to the primary target. Secondary targets hit by any bolt are dealt {{pp|key=%|75;100|1;9|formula=75% + 25% at level 9}} of the triggering {{as|attack's damage}}, reduced to {{pp|key=%|23;30|1;9|formula=23% + 7% at level 9}} against {{tip|minions}}.
P.description2: {{tip|Critical strike|Critical strikes}} instead spray 6 missiles in a 50% wider cone. Secondary targets hit count as being {{tip|critical strike|critically struck}}.

P.name: Crescendum
P.description: Basic attacks with '''Crescendum''' hurl the blade at the target, which lingers for {{fd|0.2}} seconds before homing back to '''Aphelios'''. He is unable to declare basic attacks until he retrieves '''Crescendum''', but the attack timer is reset {{tt|once caught|This does not persist when swapping weapons.}}.
P.description2: Whenever '''Aphelios''' casts an ability that would require him to throw '''Crescendum''', he instead fires a spectral ''Chakram'' at the target that similarly returns to him. '''Aphelios''' accumulates the ''Chakrams'' he catches, up to 20, which last for 5 seconds or until '''Crescendum''' is depleted of ''Moonlight''. ''Chakram'' duration is refreshed when '''Aphelios''' catches a new one or attacks a {{tip|champion}} with '''Crescendum'''.
P.description3: Attacks with '''Crescendum''' are empowered to deal {{as|{{pp|0;then + 15; then + 13.5; then + 12; then + 10.5; then + 9; then + 7.5; then + 6; then + 5*x|0 to 20 by 1|type=number of Chakrams|key=%|formula=Each Chakram grants less bonus damage than the last, starting at 15% and diminishing to 5% for 10+ Chakrams.}} AD}} {{as|'''additional''' physical damage}} and have a lower {{tip|attack windup|windup}} of {{ap|0.159999996423721/1.5*100|round=2}}%, further decreased to {{ap|0.100000001490116/1.5*100|round=2}}% when {{tip|critically strike|critically striking}}. The '''bonus''' damage from ''Chakrams'' is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

Q.name: Weapons of the Faithful
Q.description: The active effect of '''Aphelios'''' [[File:Q.png|20px|link=]] varies based on his current {{as|main weapon}}.
Q.description2: The individual actives do not share a cooldown.

Q.name: Moonshot
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' fires a bolt of energy in the target direction that deals {{as|{{pp|70 to 160 for 7|1 to 13 for 7}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{pp|42 to 60 for 7|1 to 13 for 7|key=%}} '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit.

Q.name: Onslaught
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' enters an onslaught for {{fd|1.75}} seconds, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|25%|ms}}}} {{as|(+ 10% per 100 AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} and automatically performing up to 6 {{as|(+ 2 per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed)|attack speed}} attacks over the duration against the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy, prioritizing enemy {{tip|champions}}.
Q.description2: Attacks alternate between ''Severum'' and his current {{as|off-hand}} weapon, each dealing {{as|{{pp|20 to 41 for 7|1 to 13|key=%}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}}, affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers, and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects, with on-hit damage reduced to 25% effectiveness. '''Aphelios''' cannot perform attacks while affected by {{tip|disarming crowd control}} or a {{tip|lockout}} that disables basic attacks.
Q.description3: '''''Aphelios''' cannot cast {{ai|Phase|Aphelios}} nor {{ai|Moonlight Vigil|Aphelios}} during Onslaught, but he is still able to move.''

Q.name: Binding Eclipse
Q.description: {{sbc|{{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}} - Active:}} '''Aphelios''' expunges all enemies with ''Gravitum's'' {{tip|slow}} debuff, dealing {{as|{{pp|50 to 140 for 7|1 to 13}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{pp|32 to 50 for 7|1 to 13|key=%}} '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|root|rooting}} them for 1 second.
Q.description2: ''An enemy affected by Gravitum, or an in-flight Gravitum projectile, is required to cast this ability. In-flight projectiles will be empowered to apply Binding Eclipse's effects to their targets.''

Q.name: Duskwave
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' unleashes a wave of energy in a cone in the target direction over the cast time, dealing {{as|{{pp|20 to 110 for 7|1 to 13}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{pp|15 to 21 for 7|1 to 13|key=%}} '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} to all enemies hit and locking onto each of them. After {{fd|0.25}} seconds, '''Aphelios''' then fires a volley of attacks at each locked-on target from his current {{as|off-hand}} weapon, dealing {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. The damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers. There is no {{sti|range}} limit for locked-on targets.

Q.name: Sentry
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' deploys a lunar sentry at the target location that arms after {{fd|0.35}} seconds, lasting for up to 20 seconds, during which it is inactive and {{tip|untargetable}}. The sentry activates if an enemy is within range of it, reducing its duration to 4 seconds and becoming targetable. Sentries have {{as|6 health}} and take 3 damage per {{tip|ranged}} basic attack and 4 damage per hit by abilities. {{tip|Turret}} attacks destroy sentries instantly.
Q.description2: The sentry grants {{tip|sight}} of its surroundings and autonomously attacks the nearest visible enemy in range with a replica of '''Aphelios' ''' current {{as|off-hand}} weapon, dealing {{as|{{pp|35 to 125 for 7|1 to 13}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ {{pp|34 to 52 for 7|1 to 13|key=%}} '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} per hit. The sentry can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Aphelios|crit_base}}|100}}|critical damage}} damage and benefits from both '''Aphelios'''' {{sti|attack speed|{{as|attack speed}}}} and {{sti|critical chance|{{as|critical strike chance}}}} at 100% effectiveness.
Q.description3: ''See [[Aphelios#Pets|Pets]] for more details about the sentry.''

W.name: Phase
W.description: {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Aphelios''' switches between his {{as|main weapon}} and {{as|off-hand}} weapon over {{fd|0.25}} seconds.

E.name: Weapon Queue System
E.description: The icon of this ability reflects the next weapon that is in reserve.
E.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' receives a text prompt of the weapon '''Alune''' will create next.

R.name: Moonlight Vigil
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Aphelios''' casts forth a lunar spotlight in the target direction that briefly grants {{tip|sight}} of the area along its path and stops upon illuminating an enemy {{tip|champion|champion}}. '''Alune''' smites the area centered on the illuminated target, dealing {{as|{{pp|125 to 225 for 3|6 to 16}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 20% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}} {{as|physical damage}} to enemy champions struck and locking-on to each target hit, as well as granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for 2 seconds.
R.description2:
After {{fd|0.3}} seconds of the illumination, attacks based on '''Aphelios' ''' current {{as|main weapon}} will launch from the sky against each locked-on target, dealing {{as|100% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects. These attacks can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{critical damage|100 to 130|0 to 30|critScaling=true}} damage. There is no {{sti|range}} limit for locked-on targets.
{{lc|{{ai|Calibrum|Aphelios}}}} Applies an empowered mark that deals {{as|{{pp|50 to 110 for 3|6 to 16}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}}} per ''mark'' consumed.
{{lc|{{ai|Severum|Aphelios}}}} {{tip|Heals}} '''Aphelios''' for {{pp|250 to 450 for 3|6 to 16|color=heal}} if at least one enemy champion is hit.
{{lc|{{ai|Gravitum|Aphelios}}}} Increases the initial {{tip|slow}} to 99% and empowers ''{{ai|Binding Eclipse|Aphelios}}'' to {{tip|root}} targets affected by the enhanced slow for {{fd|1.35}} seconds.
{{lc|{{ai|Infernum|Aphelios}}}} The initial blast deals {{as|{{pp|50 to 150 for 3|6 to 16}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 25% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.{{ft|The attack instead deals {{as|110% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} against locked-on targets, and causes an explosion of bolts in a 400-radius circle that deals {{as|{{pp|key=%|110*0.75*0.9 to 110*0.9 for 2|1 to 9}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}} to targets hit.|Performs ''Infernum's'' attacks and ''Infernum's'' bolts in a 400-radius circle: primary targets are dealt ''Infernum's'' primary damage; secondary targets are dealt 90% of ''Infernum's'' regular bolt damage; both are modified by ''Moonlight Vigil's'' {{sti|{{as|critical damage}}}} modifier.}}Enemy champions will take damage from overlapping areas.
{{lc|{{ai|Crescendum|Aphelios}}}} Generates 5 additional spectral ''Chakrams'' that return to '''Aphelios''' from the first enemy champion hit, for a total of 6, on top of those from other targets hit.
